intro: Primal Torntusk of Revantusk Village says Vilebranch savages carried off her mate, Elder Torntusk, in a bold midnight raid. Spies say he is alive and held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, and she asks you to save him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My mate was taken by Vilebranch savages in a bold midnight raid on our village. Our spies have told me that he is still alive and being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor. The Vile Priestess Hexx is said to be preparing him for a sacrifice to the faceless blood God, Hakkar.
You must save him, friend! Our village could not stand a loss this great.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You must act quickly, friend. Surely the guards have been alerted to your presence.
